QuestInfo.name: History Repeats
QuestInfo.0: You received an urgent message from Lan Yi.
QuestInfo.1: You can hear the screams of your pupils. Why is it that bad things happen whenever you're away?! There's no time to lose!
QuestInfo.2:
You rushed back after getting word that the Xuanshan School was in danger, soon hearing the screams of your students. Wu Shen's power grew stronger as you frantically scaled Xuanshan. 
Perhaps your desperate need to protect others was the key? You feel confident that the path you're on is the same as Wu Shen's will.

#e'Do not lose sight of yourself, Xuan. You may carry Wu Shen's legacy, but you are a person unto yourself. It is you who decides how you will live.'#n

0.conditionContent: Go to the Xuanshan Mountain Vantage
